title: Lidarr bridge
summary: Would request albums and follow artists in your self-hosted Lidarr, and show what Lidarr is still looking for.
detail: This build does not request music and does not reach Lidarr.
Would match by MusicBrainz ID, which the server reads from tags at scan time.
Would reach only the exact Lidarr host and port the owner granted, through the server's one egress client.
The Lidarr API key would be an encrypted owner-scoped secret; members never see it and it never reaches a log.
Would show wanted, monitored and missing states from Lidarr's own wanted list.
Library refresh after an import stays with the server's path-scoped refresh, not this record.
The record is a target the R2 plugin host's later package (WP-243, record 32) could name.
